title: emergencyWithdraw skips _updatePool, over-attributes accrual to remaining stakers
description: emergencyWithdraw decrements totalStaked without calling _updatePool first. The next _updatePool call computes accRewardPerShare += reward * 1e18 / totalStaked using the reduced denominator for the elapsed pre-exit window. Remaining stakers get a higher share of pre-exit period accrual than they earned. Exiter's forfeited rewards redistribute incorrectly.
remediation: Provide a no-revert on-chain-state-only _updatePoolNoHook() variant and call it before totalStaked -= amount, so share history is preserved even with a broken dispatcher.
